messages:
Anne L: Quick sync — planning a payments schema update (add payments.legacy_id) + backfill. Proposed slot: Thu Mar 26 01:00-02:00 UTC. Who can own the deploy and smoke? Need rollback readiness and a short checklist. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Miguel R: I can own the deploy. Prefer to start at 01:10 so infra warmup at 01:00. Will stay until 02:30. What are the backfill size/strategy?
Jen (DBA): Backfill estimate: ~18m if we chunk by 1M rows and run on replicas. We should create the new column + index in advance (non-blocking). Recommend backfill in 3 chunks, validate counts after each. Dual-write shim added for 15m to catch late writers.
SRE Oncall: I'll be on for the window. Monitoring: replica lag threshold 30s (warn), abort if >120s. I'll run pre-checks 30m before and post smoke checks.
Miguel R: Sounds good. Plan for deploy steps: 1) schema add column (no lock), 2) deploy app with shard-aware dual-write flag, 3) backfill chunks 4) lift dual-write after validation.
Anne L: Can we list the smoke queries we want to run after each chunk?
Jen (DBA): Smoke queries (quick):
```
SELECT count(*) FROM payments WHERE legacy_id IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1;
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE legacy_id IS NULL) FROM payments LIMIT 1;
-- spot-check a few tx_ids against newest writes
SELECT id, legacy_id, updated_at FROM payments ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 5;
```
Miguel R: I'll add a small integration smoke that runs a payment-create -> read back cycle and verify legacy_id set when flag enabled.
Kevin P: Heads-up to support: minimal visible impact expected; we'll send a short status note in #support during the window. I can draft the blurb. :speech_balloon:
deploy-bot: CI checks passed for payments-service @miguel. Canary deploy image: gcr/redwood/payments:v2026-03-25-1145.
Anne L: Rollback plan: if backfill slow or lag spike, abort remaining chunks, flip app flag to read-only mode for legacy_id, and revert service to previous image. Jen, can you script a fast reversal of writes if needed?
Jen (DBA): Yes — we have a reversal script to stop dual writes and drop index if we need to rollback. Will keep it staged under /infra/runbooks/payments/rollback.sh and test it in staging earlier today.
SRE Oncall: I'll prepare an automation hook to cancel running backfill if lag > 120s and post alert to this thread.
Anne L: OK locking in slot Thu Mar 26 01:00-02:00 UTC. Owners: Miguel (deploy), Jen (DBA/backfill), SRE Oncall (monitoring), Kevin (support comms). I'll post a short Runbook in #eng-platform 12h before. :white_check_mark:
Miguel R: I'll create the deploy PR and ping for reviews. ETA PR by EOD today.
Kevin P: I'll schedule a short support stand-by for the window.
Anne L: Thanks all — we’ll reconfirm 12h out.
